packs.blocker_reason: Huawei Cloud's site terms reserve all rights and require prior written consent to reproduce, modify or distribute site content, and express written permission to use its logos. No license or written consent covering its icons was found, so none may be bundled or substituted.

terms.summary: Site terms: content may not be reproduced, modified, distributed or otherwise used without prior written consent, and trademarks or logos may not be used without express prior written permission.
Huawei's corporate terms state the same consent requirement for website content and marks.

candidates.note: Huawei-operated manifest of 196 logos; every architecture icon is marked planned; no license field. It covers 15 of the 17 named items; Subnet and Security Group have no entry and stay labeled boundaries.
Regional publisher account with SVG libraries; no license file and null GitHub license metadata.
Community repack of a third-party site's PNGs; no license file.

conditions: Bundle nothing, and render no generic substitute, until written consent or a clear license covers extraction, local conversion, bundling and generated diagrams
